app.name: mise
page.recipes.title: Recipes
page.plan.title: This week
page.groceries.title: Groceries
page.settings.title: Settings
error.notFound.title: Page not found
error.notFound.body: The page you were looking for doesn't exist.
error.internal.title: Something went wrong
error.internal.body: Please try again in a moment.
auth.panel.headline: Recipes, plan and groceries in one place.
auth.panel.sub: Self-hosted, so your data stays on your server.
signin.title: Sign in
signin.lead: Sign in to get to your recipes, plan and lists.
signin.leadWide: Welcome back. Sign in to continue.
signin.newHere: New here? Ask someone in your household for an invite link.
signin.error.invalid: That username and password don't match. Check both and try again.
signin.error.tooMany: Too many attempts. Wait a minute, then try again.
forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.askAdmin.title: Ask an admin
forgot.askAdmin.body: This mise server isn't set up to send emails. Ask an admin in your household to set a new password for you in Settings → People.
setup.title: Set up mise
setup.lead: Create your household and the first admin account. You can invite everyone else afterwards.
setup.panel.headline: Everything in its place, starting now.
setup.panel.sub: This runs once. The household you create here is where recipes, the plan and lists live.
setup.timezoneHint: An IANA name like Europe/Vienna. Days and weeks follow this zone.
setup.baseURLHint: The address people use to reach mise. Invite links start with it.
field.name: Name
field.usernameHint: Letters, numbers, dots, dashes and underscores. Not case-sensitive.
form.error.url: Enter a web address starting with http:// or https://.
form.error.email: Enter an email address like name@example.com.
form.error.timezone: Use a time zone name like Europe/Vienna.
form.error.baseURL: Enter a full address starting with http:// or https://.
form.error.usernameChars: Use only letters, numbers, dots, dashes and underscores.
accept.title: Create your account
accept.share: You'll share recipes, the plan and lists in %s.
accept.panel.headline: Cook from the same recipes, plan and list.
accept.invalid.title: This invite doesn't work
accept.invalid.body: The link has expired, was revoked or was already used. Ask for a new one.
settings.peopleNote: Everyone shares the same recipes, plan and lists.
account.title: Account
account.visibleNote: Others see your name and initial next to items and recipes you add.
account.passwordOthersSignedOut: Your other devices are signed out when you change it.
account.deleteNote: To delete your account, ask an admin. Recipes you added stay for everyone else.
invite.title: Invite someone
invite.lead: They'll share your recipes, plan and lists.
invite.emailHint: To remember who the link is for. This server isn’t set up to send emails.
invite.expiry: Invites expire after 7 days and work once.
invite.linkHint: Send this link yourself. It's shown only once, expires after 7 days and works once.
member.isYou: This is you. Change your own name and password on your account page.
member.resetHint: Tell %s the new password. Their devices are signed out.
member.removeBody: %s can no longer sign in. Recipes and items they added stay.
member.error.lastAdmin: The household needs at least one admin. Make someone else admin first.
member.error.self: You can't do that to your own account.
member.error.sharedAccount: This account also belongs to another household, so only its owner can change the password.
notice.passwordChanged: Password changed. Your other devices are signed out.
notice.othersSignedOut: Your other devices are signed out.
error.forbidden.title: Admins only
error.forbidden.body: Only admins of your household can open this page.
groceries.empty.title: All done
groceries.empty.body: Nothing left to buy. Add what you need below, or start from things you buy often.
groceries.gone.title: This list was deleted
groceries.gone.body: Someone in your household deleted it. Your other lists are still there.
groceries.suggest.amountNote: picked up from what you typed
groceries.suggest.keys: ↑ ↓ to choose · Enter to add · Esc to close
groceries.toast.gone: That item is no longer on the list.
groceries.edit.title: Edit %s
groceries.edit.categoryHint: Remembered for next time you add %s.
groceries.edit.newCategoryHint: Creates the category and puts the item in it.
groceries.edit.renameHint: Renames the item everywhere it's used.
groceries.clear.title: Clear the cart?
groceries.clear.body: %s is shared, so these checked items disappear for everyone. Items still to get stay on the list.
groceries.clear.note: They'll come back as suggestions under Usually bought.
groceries.error.categoryExists: There's already a category with that name.
recipes.error.tagExists: There's already a tag with that name.
groceries.error.itemExists: There's already an item with that name.
groceries.error.lastList: Keep at least one list. Create another before deleting this one.
settings.listsNote: The first list opens by default.
notice.categoryDeleted: Category deleted. Its items are uncategorised now.
categories.title: Categories & aisles
categories.lead: Groceries are sorted in this order. Match the way you walk through your usual shop.
categories.dragHint: Drag a row, or use the arrows.
categories.deleteNote: Its items become uncategorised. Lists keep them.
categories.footer: Changes apply to every list, for everyone.
recipes.sort.name: Name A–Z
recipes.empty.title: No recipes yet
recipes.empty.body: Write down the dishes you cook. Their ingredients can go straight onto your shopping list.
recipes.noMatch.title: No recipes match these filters.
recipes.filter.title: Filter
recipes.search.title: Search recipes
recipes.search.label: Search recipes by name or ingredient
recipes.search.noneBody: Nothing in your %d recipes matches by name or by ingredient.
recipes.menu.shared: Added by %s · shared with everyone in your household
recipes.menu.shareNote: Opens for people signed in to this server
recipes.gone.title: This recipe was deleted
recipes.gone.body: Someone in your household deleted it.
recipes.onList: %d of %d on %s · tap + to add one
recipes.method.hint: Highlighted amounts follow the servings above.
recipes.method.highlightHint: Ingredients you mention in a step get highlighted with their amount.
recipes.delete.title: Delete “%s”?
recipes.delete.listStays: Items already on your list stay there.
recipes.edit.title: Edit recipe
recipes.edit.addPlaceholder: Add ingredient, e.g. “2 tbsp soy sauce”
recipes.edit.ingredientsHint: Ingredients link to your grocery items, so they can go straight to your list.
recipes.edit.notesHint: Everyone in your household sees and can edit notes.
recipes.edit.photoHint: JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 15 MB.
recipes.photo.tooLarge: That photo is larger than 15 MB. Pick a smaller one.
recipes.photo.tooManyPixels: That photo is too big to process. Pick a smaller one.
recipes.photo.heic: HEIC photos aren't supported. Convert to JPEG or pick from Photos.
recipes.photo.unsupported: That file isn't a JPEG, PNG or WebP image.
tags.title: Recipe tags
tags.lead: Tags power the filters on Recipes. Renaming a tag updates every recipe that has it.
tags.empty: No tags yet. Add one here or while editing a recipe.
tags.footer: “Under 30 min” comes from prep and cook time, not a tag.
tags.mergeHint: Recipes tagged %s get the chosen tag instead, and this tag goes away.
tags.deleteNote: Removes it from %d recipes. The recipes stay.
tags.deleteNoteOne: Removes it from 1 recipe. The recipe stays.
plan.month.legend: Past days are faded. Drop a meal on a planned day to swap the two.
plan.hint.phone: Tap a meal to move or change it, or press and hold to drag it.
plan.hint.web: Click a meal for options, or drag it to another day. Drop it on a planned day to swap. Drag suggestions in from below.
plan.mealLabel: %s on %s. Open options to move, change or remove, or drag to move.
plan.stale.title: Haven’t cooked in a while
plan.stale.dragPhone: Tap one to plan it, or drag it onto a day.
plan.shop.title: Shopping for this week
plan.shop.body: Moving a meal doesn’t change the list. Adding one asks before putting its ingredients on %s.
plan.addTo.title: Add to plan
plan.addTo.none: Nothing from this recipe is on it yet.
plan.addTo.both: Already planned: %s. Both will show that day.
plan.pick.title: Plan a meal
plan.menu.removeNote: The recipe stays in your library. You can undo.
plan.move.now: It’s on %s now. Pick another day.
plan.move.swapNote: %s is on %s. Swap the two meals, or keep both on that day.
plan.servings.note: Only for this meal on %s. The recipe itself stays at %s; amounts already on the list stay as they are.
plan.toast.gone: That meal is no longer on the plan.
install.title: First shop done. Keep mise one tap away?
install.body: Add it to your home screen and your lists open full screen, like an app.
forgot.intro: Enter the email on your account and we’ll send you a reset link.
forgot.sent.title: Check your inbox
forgot.sent.body: If that email belongs to an account, a link is on its way. It works for 1 hour.
forgot.noEmail: No email on your account? Ask an admin to reset your password in Settings → People.
reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.intro: For your account %s. Your other devices will be signed out.
reset.invalid.title: This link doesn’t work anymore
reset.invalid.body: Reset links work for 1 hour and only once. Ask for a new one.
invite.emailHintSend: We’ll email them the link too.
invite.mail.failed: The email couldn’t be sent. Share the link yourself; it works all the same.
email.ignore: If you didn’t expect this email, you can ignore it.
email.fallback: If the button doesn’t work, copy this address into your browser:
email.invite.subject: %s invited you to %s on mise
email.invite.body: %s invited you to join %s on mise, to share recipes, the meal plan and shopping lists.
email.invite.note: The link works once and expires after 7 days.
email.reset.subject: Reset your mise password
email.reset.body: someone asked to reset the password of your mise account %s. Choose a new one with this link:
email.reset.note: The link works once, for 1 hour. Your password stays the same until you choose a new one.
ai.settings.title: AI import
ai.settings.enabledNote: Nothing is sent to the model until someone starts an import. Pages with recipe data import without AI either way.
ai.settings.endpointHint: Not used for the Anthropic API. For Ollama, blank means http://localhost:11434/v1.
ai.settings.modelHint: For Ollama, pick a model that supports tool calls.
ai.settings.keyHint: Stored on your server, never shown again. Not needed for Ollama.
ai.settings.keyStored: A key is stored. Leave this blank to keep it. Changing the provider or endpoint removes it.
ai.settings.keyReplace: (enter a new one to replace it)
ai.settings.keyUnreadable: The stored key can't be read on this server, probably after a restore without secret.key. Enter it again.
ai.settings.toolsFoot: Imports always open as a draft you check before saving. The AI can't delete or change existing recipes, items or lists.
ai.tool.fetchPageNote: Open other pages of the recipe's site, such as a print view
ai.tool.searchItemsNote: Match ingredients to items you already have
ai.tool.createItemNote: Propose items that don't exist yet; they're added only when you save
ai.tool.createRecipeNote: Always as a draft you check before saving
ai.error.endpoint: Enter an http or https URL without a username or password.
ai.error.modelLong: That model name is too long.
ai.error.key: That doesn't look like an API key.
ai.error.keyRequired: Enter an API key to turn on AI import with the Anthropic API.
